---
title: "Plot backgrounds"
format:
  revealjs:
    theme: [default, plot-background.scss]
---

## White plot, off-white slide {#opaque}

```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-asp: 0.5
plot(mpg ~ disp, data = mtcars, col = factor(am), pch = 16, bty = "n")
```

## Transparent plot {#transparent}

```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-asp: 0.5
#| dev: png
#| dev.args: !expr list(bg = "transparent")
plot(mpg ~ disp, data = mtcars, col = factor(am), pch = 16, bty = "n")
```
